description: On the very first Start (no earlier attempt), the Welcome form shows the resume notice "An earlier attempt to start “Checkout rewrite” didn't confirm. Starting it again resumes that attempt." for the whole Starting… period. The notice also pushes the helper text and the button down by ~78px while the request is in flight.
expected: The resume notice appears only when a previous attempt from an earlier submit is still pending (after a failure or reload), never during the first in-flight request.
actual: A MutationObserver saw the notice render during the first Starting…; the screenshot shows the notice next to the disabled Starting… button.
suggested_fix: Show the notice only when pending-create existed when the form mounted (or after a failed submit), not when it was written by the current submit.

description: The agent (robot) badge for Wren is drawn at the bottom-left of Wren's avatar, so it sits under the corner of Priya's PN avatar and reads as Priya's badge.
expected: The agent badge reads unambiguously as belonging to the agent avatar (e.g. bottom-right, inside its own avatar bounds).
actual: Robot glyph at x~830 overlaps the gap between PN (786-818) and W (827-859).
suggested_fix: Anchor .avatar-kind to the bottom-right of the agent avatar, or move the presence dot and kind glyph to opposite corners.

description: Priya appears twice in the header: as the first avatar in "People in this project" and as the "You: Priya Natarajan" button with the same PN avatar.
expected: The signed-in person is shown once in the header.
actual: Two PN avatars 150px apart, both opening a profile.
suggested_fix: Omit the current Actor from the avatar stack, or merge the You button into the stack.

description: At 390x844 the board header takes ~235px (three rows: project, avatars+Invite, You button, then Saved/New task) and the You button truncates to "You: Priya Nataraj…"; only one and a half columns of the board fit.
expected: A compact header on phone width that leaves room for the board.
actual: Header, tabs and three stacked filters fill the first 545px; the board starts below.
suggested_fix: Collapse filters behind a Filter button and fold the You button into the avatar stack at narrow widths.
